docs.text: Loch Ness is the largest lake (by volume) in the UK. Its incredible size is the main reason why people believe there COULD be a Loch Ness Monster. Lake Ontario is 200x larger than Loch Ness. I hope you enjoy my next story: 200 Loch Ness Monsters.
I live on the shore of Lake Ontario and was not prepared to be *quite* so underwhelmed by Loch Lomond, the largest lake by surface area in the UK. It’s beautiful! But not large!
Switzerland, a country just half the size of Lake Superior, has about 3241 miles of railway, some of the routes being amazingly beautiful. [🇨🇭 myswitzerand] Original post
